description: This file defines an interface class 'AudioSource' that provides a method for accessing audio data streams originating from a client. The interface includes a pure virtual function 'GetMoreAudioData' which retrieves audio data and indicates if the stream is muted.

classes.name: AudioSource
classes.description: An abstract interface class for sourcing audio data streams from a client, requiring implementation of the 'GetMoreAudioData' method.

methods.name: GetMoreAudioData
methods.description: Retrieves more audio data into the provided buffer. Returns the number of bytes read or a negative value if an error occurs. Sets 'muted' to true if the audio stream is muted, indicating the data should be considered silent.
